summary: Frontend-only login flow retest for Earn2Love admin panel. All 3 requested scenarios PASS via the live UI at /login: (1) PRIMARY demo super_admin (demo.admin@earn2love.com / Earn2Love@Demo2026) logs in and redirects to '/' with full authenticated shell (sidebar, dashboard live data, top-right shows 'demo.admin@earn2love.com' + 'super_admin'). (2) SECONDARY earn2loveofficial@gmail.com also logs in and redirects to '/'. (3) NEGATIVE wrong password stays on /login and displays 'Invalid email or password' error inline under the password field. Dashboard renders live Firestore data (Total Users 8, Active 2, Revenue £12,010, charts, etc.) with no auth-related console errors. Only console 'error' seen is the expected 400 from Firebase signInWithPassword during the wrong-password negative test.
test_credentials: demo.admin@earn2love.com / Earn2Love@Demo2026 (super_admin, works); earn2loveofficial@gmail.com / Earn2Love#Admin2026 (super_admin, works)
seed_data_creation: None (live Firebase project, no user creation/deletion performed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow verified working end-to-end via UI. AuthContext.loginEmail + /api/auth/me integration is healthy. If retesting, clear localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB between logins because Firebase persists auth; otherwise /login redirects immediately when already authenticated. Login form testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. Error label appears in a red-tinted div (text 'Invalid email or password') but does not use a .error/[role=alert] class — use text selector to assert.
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced. The user's original complaint 'cant able to login because of firestore auth' does NOT reproduce with the current build. Both super_admin accounts sign in via Firebase Email/Password provider, backend /api/auth/me returns role=super_admin, and the UI navigates to '/'. Likely user-side issue (wrong password / stale cached session / different account without admin custom claim).
